methodology: Public research performed on 7 September 2026 using employer career pages, vendor-hosted customer material and public professional profile search extracts. No contacting, authenticated profile access, contact-data brokers or private user documents were used.

confirmed means directly readable employer evidence explicitly describes Bengaluru Pega engineering/delivery. supported means explicit local role evidence exists in a search index or self-reported professional profile but current direct confirmation is incomplete. uncertain means a material link is missing; not_found means no sufficient local technical evidence was found in this bounded pass.

Employer-authored career evidence can establish a local technical function without exposing individual employees. A job page describes capability or recruitment intent; it does not prove a current opening or an existing team's size.
Verified source status means supporting content was read on direct open. search_index_only means the supporting text was available only in a search result, even when the URL belongs to an employer.
Profile URLs are left null when a profile was not directly verified; source_url preserves the actual discovered public profile URL, not a fabricated or search-result URL.

Only each profile's own About/experience or clearly self-authored professional statements were used. Liked/reposted third-party activity, certifications alone, office presence and global case studies were not treated as proof of current local Pega employment.
Excerpts are short paraphrases of observed content. published_at is null unless an absolute publication date was visible; relative index crawl/posting labels were not converted into invented dates.

Locations list only locations supported by the relevant evidence; an empty array means no local technical location was established. Domains and skills are source-supported descriptors, not proof that every member has those skills.
limitations: This is a bounded public-evidence map, not an employee directory or an exhaustive employer census.
Search indexes can lag by months, combine snippets from unrelated activity, and retain removed vacancies. Professional employment claims remain self-reported.
Observed_at and checked_at record this research date; they do not certify employment or vacancy availability on that date.
Absence of evidence is not evidence that a team does not exist. Global Pega use does not establish Bengaluru delivery.
No referral availability, reporting relationships, headcounts, attrition-based openings or willingness to change jobs is inferred.
Careers evidence includes closed requisitions because the objective is team presence. Each record flags known closure or failed live verification.
Live primary evidence was unavailable for several employers; those records are explicitly supported or uncertain rather than confirmed.
